label: Terrace Flight Venue

license.author: NemoWorld project contributors
license.source: Original NemoWorld authored content: the place manifests in src/content-manifest.js, validated against the venue machinery in world.js
license.note: Authored for this project; no third-party asset was copied. A place declares a space and the machinery it reuses and draws no new geometry. The repository carries no LICENSE file, so redistribution terms are unstated. See content/THIRD_PARTY.md.

site.machinery: world.js makeCountry(iso3) with COUNTRY_VENUE_ASSIGNMENT.NPL === 'terraces'; the 40 x 28 grid, COUNTRY_VENUE_PLAZA, the arrival (20,25), the return portal (20,26) and the walkable plaza band are the shared country-venue contract asserted by tests/country-venues.test.js

independence.statement: A fictional NemoWorld space. It is not a government, ministry, embassy or United Nations office, it does not represent any country or people, and nothing here asserts endorsement, representation or official status.

notes: Three path retaining edges with two farm beds between them, a west-edge grove mass, a pond tank and an open shelter, on the terraces shape world.js already builds for the NPL catalog entry.

This place adds no renderer code: it is a declaration of what the terraces shape places and of the contract that shape already keeps, so a change to world.js that moves the arrival, the band or the portal is refused here rather than shipped.
